categories.main_business_segments: Yidu Tech operates primarily in three segments: Big Data Platform and Solutions (AI for Medical), Life Sciences Solutions (AI for Life Science), and Health Management Platform and Solutions (AI for Care). These segments provide AI-driven healthcare data intelligence platforms, clinical research and drug development support, and health management services respectively.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technology is YiduCore, an AI Medical Brain leveraging large language models trained on over 500 billion tokens of multi-modal healthcare data, including 6 billion authorized medical records. It integrates data-driven algorithms, scenario empowerment, and continuous feedback to create a self-learning AI ecosystem. The technology stack includes multi-parameter large language models (8B to 100B parameters), AI middleware, and proprietary platforms for data governance, clinical decision support, and intelligent agents embedded in hospital workflows.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yidu Tech serves top-tier hospitals (110 clients), regulatory bodies (44 clients), multinational pharmaceutical companies (16 of top 20 MNCs), and urban residents through health insurance platforms. Its customers span hospitals, governments, pharmaceutical companies, insurance firms, and public health sectors, primarily in China with some operations in Brunei and other regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in Mainland China, accounting for 83% of revenue, with additional operations in Brunei (14%) and other international markets (3%). Its headquarters and major offices are in Beijing, with presence in Shanghai and other Chinese cities, as well as a principal place of business in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yidu Tech operates primarily in the midstream and downstream of the healthcare AI supply chain, providing AI platforms, data analytics, clinical research solutions, and health management services. It acts as a technology and service provider enabling hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, and insurers to leverage AI for healthcare delivery and research.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on deepening AI technology integration in healthcare through continuous optimization of YiduCore, expanding large language model capabilities, and enhancing scenario-driven applications. R&D priorities include improving diagnostic assistance, clinical research innovation, and health management services, with emphasis on oncology, ophthalmology, and chronic disease management. It also plans to enrich its ecosystem via strategic partnerships, investments, and acquisitions.
categories.revenue_model: Yidu Tech generates revenue primarily through sales of AI-driven healthcare data platforms and solutions, clinical research services, and health management platform subscriptions or service fees. Revenue streams include contracts with hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, government regulators, and insurance platforms, with some product sales such as pharmaceutical products included in the Big Data Platform segment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Yidu Tech positions itself as a leading AI healthcare technology provider in China, with technological leadership demonstrated by top rankings in national AI model assessments and extensive deployment in Grade III-A hospitals. Its comprehensive AI Medical Brain and integrated solutions create competitive barriers in the medical AI industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal year 2025, Yidu Tech reported revenue of RMB 715 million, a decrease of 11.4% year-on-year, with a gross profit of RMB 239 million and a narrowed loss of RMB 135 million (38.9% improvement). The company maintains strong cash reserves of over RMB 3.3 billion and employs 823 staff. Despite revenue decline in some segments, operational efficiency and profitability improved significantly.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yidu Tech emphasizes its unique AI Medical Brain, YiduCore, which integrates vast authorized healthcare data with advanced AI algorithms to deliver precise medical insights and scenario-empowered solutions. Its products enable hospitals and pharmaceutical companies to improve diagnostic accuracy, clinical research efficiency, and patient care quality. The company’s focus on professional medical validation, scenario integration, and AI-driven operational efficiency differentiates it in the healthcare AI market.
